purpose: Verify that structural mapping, evidence-derived criticism, constructed repair and genuinely acquired retained operators causally connect in an executable engineering path. No scientific or commercial superiority is implied by mechanism completion.
unchanged_objective: For the admitted finite typed evidence protocol, preserve valid completion under required dependency order; catchable interruption after reservation must preserve an incomplete record without a false COMPLETE record, and refused replay must not mutate evidence. Additional typed resource-compensation obligations are checked where explicitly specified.
freeze_rule: The verifier records exact candidate, interpreter, broker, memory, critic, source and acceptance specification identities before selecting fresh tasks. Candidate source is not edited by the verifier. Any later builder repair changes identity and exposed cases become regression evidence.
exposure_history: Cycle004's eight tasks and all prior criticisms, failures and controls are exposed regressions. They are never relabeled fresh confirmation. Cycle005 development traces may guide acquisition; the exact successor cases are selected only after final source freeze.

variations: Unseen target event identifiers and phase listing orders
Different causal/dependency layouts within the supplied grammar
Different admissible failure locations and learned roles
Refusal of incompatible units/causality or unsupported applicability
fresh_panel.separation: Verifier controls case selection and final checks without candidate edits. Same model family, tools, host, libraries and shared filesystem mean procedural separation, not external independent certification or OS-protected secrecy.
fresh_panel.claim_scope: Finite engineering transfer/generalization; not eight consequential scientific domains or statistical evidence of unrestricted invention.

whole_path_requirements: A supplied source mechanism is structurally matched to the development task and its selected role correspondences determine constructed event IDs or parameters.

A real failing execution produces a bounded evidence witness. The critic derives the failed obligation and target location from that witness; a changed failing location must change the extracted constraint. Unsupported criticism remains unresolved and cannot drive accepted repair.
The constructor consumes only established constraints or supported mapping obligations and changes executable program behavior, while final acceptance remains outside candidate control.

An acquired operator is derived from the verified before/after development artifacts and trace, with evidence/source identities and scoped applicability. It is not a literal operator constant supplied by the evaluator.
The acquired record is actually stored, retrieved, applicability/dependency/source checked and instantiated into a fresh successor construction through the public pipeline.
The verifier's successor arm never injects a hand-authored operator, bypasses retained retrieval or substitutes a direct constructor call for the claimed inherited path.
Generated event plans execute only through the qualified fixed interpreter/broker with declared effects and bounds. Actual effect outcomes and normal completion are independently checked.
The implementation works from a clean source archive without .git or a private working-tree dependency, preserving previous source editions and original evidence.

controls.strong_conventional: Competent topological ordering, appropriate protection/atomic publication and resource compensation using the same task information and final acceptance.
controls.ordinary_equivalent_reuse: Give the control the identical acquired generative record/content and matching source/applicability checks; report ties without inventing a structured-memory advantage.
controls.mapping_removed: Omit structural mapping-derived obligations while retaining the same useful objective, final checks and authorized task metadata.
controls.critic_removed: Do not convert the development failure witness into corrective obligations; preserve final correctness checks.
controls.operator_removed: Retain evidence/metadata but remove the acquired generative operator; no hidden default operator replacement.
controls.resource_rule: Apply the same declared task access, source content and search allowance to comparable arms, charge failed branches, and distinguish marginal execution from acquisition and complete lifecycle costs. Simpler conventional methods may win.

negative_controls: Forged or hash-mismatched before/after acquisition receipt
Changed failure location or stale witness
Duplicate record and replay evidence preservation
decision_rule: Report each mechanism link and each arm separately. Missing or bypassed acquisition/retrieval, literal evaluator-supplied operators, unchanged construction under claimed role-changing mappings, unsupported criticism promoted to a repair, unsafe accepted output or an unqualified execution boundary fails that corresponding engineering requirement. No conventional-control advantage is required merely to establish correctly connected implementation, but no advantage may be claimed from a tie or loss.
commercial_boundary: No buyer participation, paid acceptance, complete-cost profit, unrestricted earned funds or funded successor is inferred from engineering qualification. Real spending, outreach and transactions are not performed.
